 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Mirror the patterned rectangle horizontally into the zero rectangle.
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in g))
    coords = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg and v != 0]
    zeros = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    if not coords or not zeros:
        return g
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in coords),max(r for r,c in coords)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in coords),max(c for r,c in coords)
    tr0,tr1=min(r for r,c in zeros),max(r for r,c in zeros)
    tc0,tc1=min(c for r,c in zeros),max(c for r,c in zeros)
    for dr in range(min(r1-r0+1,tr1-tr0+1)):
        for dc in range(min(c1-c0+1,tc1-tc0+1)):
            g[tr0+dr][tc0+dc] = g[r0+dr][c1-dc]
    return g
"
